entry.name: showCameraIndicator
entry.label: Show the camera-in-use indicator in the panel.

entry.name: showMicIndicator
entry.label: Show the microphone-in-use indicator in the panel.

entry.name: showNetworkIcon
entry.label: Show the network (Wi-Fi/ethernet) icon in the panel.

entry.name: showVolumeIcon
entry.label: Show the volume icon in the panel.

entry.name: showBatteryIcon
entry.label: Show the battery icon (and percentage) in the panel.

entry.name: showBatteryPercent
entry.label: Show the battery percentage next to the battery icon in horizontal panels.

entry.name: showVolumeSlider
entry.label: Show the output-volume slider.

entry.name: showMicSlider
entry.label: Show the input-volume (microphone) slider.

entry.name: showBrightnessSlider
entry.label: Show the screen-brightness slider.

entry.name: showWifiTile
entry.label: Show the Wi-Fi tile.

entry.name: showBluetoothTile
entry.label: Show the Bluetooth tile.

entry.name: showPowerModeTile
entry.label: Show the Power Mode tile.

entry.name: showNightLightTile
entry.label: Show the Night Light tile.

entry.name: showDarkStyleTile
entry.label: Show the Dark Style tile.

entry.name: showDoNotDisturbTile
entry.label: Show the Do Not Disturb tile.

entry.name: showAirplaneModeTile
entry.label: Show the Airplane Mode tile.

entry.name: showClipboardTile
entry.label: Show the Clipboard tile.

entry.name: showKdeConnectTile
entry.label: Show the KDE Connect tile.

entry.name: showDevicesTile
entry.label: Show the Disks & Devices tile.

entry.name: showInputMethodTile
entry.label: Show the Input Method tile.

entry.name: showScreenshotButton
entry.label: Show the screenshot button.

entry.name: showSettingsButton
entry.label: Show the System Settings button.

entry.name: showLockButton
entry.label: Show the Lock Screen button.

entry.name: showPowerButton
entry.label: Show the Shut Down / Restart / Log Out button.

entry.name: showMediaCard
entry.label: Show the media player card when a player is running.

entry.name: mediaPosition
entry.label: Where the media player card sits: top (above the header row), default (below the header), or belowpills (below the tray pill rows and above the footer rows).

entry.name: showTrayFooter
entry.label: Show the Tray & Background Apps footer row.

entry.name: showDndInNotifications
entry.label: Show the "Do Not Disturb" switch on the Notifications page (it is hidden by default; the main page has its own Do Not Disturb tile).

entry.name: pinnedSnis
entry.label: List of StatusNotifierItem "service|path" pairs to show as pills in the main grid. Pipe character separates the service from the D-Bus object path.

entry.name: showSniPills
entry.label: Show every system tray app as a pill in the main page (instead of only the pinned ones). The pill's arrow opens its context menu.

entry.name: screenshotBackend
entry.label: Screenshot tool to use. One of: auto, spectacle, grim, flameshot, gnome-screenshot, maim.

entry.name: screenshotDefaultMode
entry.label: Default screenshot mode when the screenshot button is clicked. One of: fullscreen, region, window.
